_doc: Free vs slave status of US states and territories, 1820-1863, for TerritoryOverTime (src/motion/territory.tsx). Each state/territory has a timeline of {date (ISO), status}; status at a date = the last entry on or before it (none before the first entry = not yet US / not shown). State ids are FIPS codes in src/data/geo/us-states-10m.json; modern state outlines stand in for historical ones. Territories are approximate polygons (ring [lon,lat], or an `acquisition` key from usGeo ACQUISITIONS) drawn under the states and clipped to the US outline; every one is flagged approximate. Status colours are theme roles assigned in code (src/theme/tokens.ts), not stored here.

keyYears.event: Missouri Compromise (Mar 6, 1820); Maine admitted free (Mar 15, 1820): 12 free, 11 slave states
keyYears.source: National Archives, Milestone Documents: 'Missouri Compromise (1820)'; Library of Congress, 'Missouri Compromise: Primary Documents in American History'; U.S. Senate Historical Office, 'States in the Senate: dates of admission'; National Archives, statehood enabling acts and proclamations
keyYears.note: Admission dates and free/slave counts verified (counts derived from verified admission dates). Missouri Compromise date (Mar 6, 1820) not re-retrieved this session.

keyYears.event: Missouri admitted as a slave state (Aug 10, 1821): 12 free, 12 slave states
keyYears.source: National Archives, Milestone Documents: 'Missouri Compromise (1820)'; Library of Congress, 'Missouri Compromise: Primary Documents in American History'; U.S. Senate Historical Office, 'States in the Senate: dates of admission'; National Archives, statehood enabling acts and proclamations
keyYears.note: Admission dates and free/slave counts verified (counts derived from verified admission dates).

keyYears.event: Compromise of 1850: California admitted free (Sept 9, 1850); Utah and New Mexico Territories organized with popular sovereignty: 16 free, 15 slave states
keyYears.source: National Archives, Milestone Documents: 'Compromise of 1850'; Library of Congress, 'Compromise of 1850: Primary Documents in American History'
keyYears.note: Admission dates and free/slave counts verified (counts derived from verified admission dates).

keyYears.event: Kansas-Nebraska Act (May 30, 1854): popular sovereignty in Kansas and Nebraska Territories; Missouri Compromise line repealed
keyYears.source: Wikipedia, 'Kansas–Nebraska Act' (signed by Pierce May 30, 1854; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kansas%E2%80%93Nebraska_Act); U.S. Senate Historical Office, 'The Kansas-Nebraska Act' (https://www.senate.gov/artandhistory/history/minute/Kansas_Nebraska_Act.htm)

keyYears.event: Eleven states secede (South Carolina Dec 20, 1860 to Tennessee June 8, 1861); four slave states (DE, MD, KY, MO) stay in the Union
keyYears.source: Wikipedia, 'Confederate States of America', order of secession resolutions and dates (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Confederate_States_of_America; ordinance texts via archived civilwar ordinance pages); border states per same article
